mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 1) || ' ' || REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 2)) FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND ADDRESS1 IS NOT NULL

WITH me AS ( SELECT MEMBER_SEQ, GENDER, REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 1) AS SIDO, REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 2) AS SIGUNGU FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} ), cand AS ( SELECT m.MEMBER_SEQ, NVL(p.NICKNAME, m.NICKNAME) AS NICKNAME, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, m.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) AS AGE, REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(m.ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 1) AS SIDO, REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(m.ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 2) AS SIGUNGU, p.INTRODUCTION, p.MBTI, p.JOB FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE p ON p.MEMBER_SEQ = m.MEMBER_SEQ CROSS JOIN me WHERE m.MEMBER_SEQ <> me.MEMBER_SEQ AND m.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND m.GENDER <> me.GENDER AND m.ADDRESS1 IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_BLOCK b WHERE (b.MEMBER_SEQ = me.MEMBER_SEQ AND b.BLOCKED_MEMBER_SEQ = m.MEMBER_SEQ) OR (b.MEMBER_SEQ = m.MEMBER_SEQ AND b.BLOCKED_MEMBER_SEQ = me.MEMBER_SEQ)) ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.MEMBER_SEQ AS member_seq, c.NICKNAME AS nickname, c.AGE AS age, c.SIDO || ' ' || c.SIGUNGU AS region, CASE WHEN c.SIGUNGU = me.SIGUNGU THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS near_rank, c.INTRODUCTION AS introduction, c.MBTI AS mbti, c.JOB AS job FROM cand c CROSS JOIN me WHERE c.SIDO = me.SIDO ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.SIGUNGU = me.SIGUNGU THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
